description: This file defines the PaginationParameters class, which encapsulates pagination parameters such as limit, offset, order by, and sort order for database queries. It provides methods to generate SQL snippet strings for pagination purposes.

classes.name: PaginationParameters
classes.description: A data class for holding pagination query parameters such as limit, offset, ordering, and sorting options.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit value or a default max limit; null indicates no limit.

methods.name: hasOrderBy
methods.description: Checks if the orderBy string is specified and not blank.

methods.name: hasSortOrder
methods.description: Checks if the sortOrder string is specified and not blank.

methods.name: hasLimit
methods.description: Checks if the limit is set and greater than zero.

methods.name: hasOffset
methods.description: Checks if the offset is specified.

methods.name: orderBySql
methods.description: Generates the ORDER BY SQL clause based on orderBy and sortOrder.

methods.name: limitSql
methods.description: Generates the LIMIT/OFFSET SQL clause based on limit and offset.

methods.name: paginationSql
methods.description: Combines orderBySql and limitSql to generate a full pagination SQL snippet.
